talking_points: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Wallet lets its AI agents actually spend your money, with biometric sign-off before every purchase.
The Federal Reserve's own staff now rank AI as the single biggest risk to financial stability, even as US banking regulators warn about credit exposure to the data-centre boom.
Fintech valuations keep climbing fast — Rogo at $2bn and Rox at $1.3bn — while OpenAI quietly dissolved its robotics team, betting that general-purpose models can run machines too.
